refuter_findings.location: Definition, analytic-index paragraph beginning “If an L² realization”
refuter_findings.evidence: The Definition says, “If an L² realization A:H¹(M,E⁺)→L²(M,E⁻) is Fredholm,” and adds only that “Fredholmness is a hypothesis here.” It gives no Fredholm criterion or exact supplier; the sole declared dependency is def-axiom-of-choice. The criterion in lem-equivariant-controlled-symbol-realization is not declared or identified as a supplier here.

refuter_findings.location: Statement, first paragraph defining ch_h(V) and ch_{h,c}(a)
refuter_findings.evidence: The Statement uses the “ordinary rational Chern character” on F and the relative character on T*F. The exact definition in def-chern-character-of-a-complex-vector-bundle begins, “Let E→X be a numerable complex vector bundle over a finite CW complex X”; lem-graded-chern-character-respects-relative-maps-and-skeletal-filtrations likewise covers finite CW pairs. Although finite-CW-model suppliers are listed, the Statement does not define transport from a chosen model to F or T*F, or its independence from that choice.

reader_findings.location: ## Definition, analytic-index paragraph beginning “If an L² realization”

reader_findings.location: ## Statement, first paragraph defining ch_h(V) and ch_{h,c}(a)
reader_findings.evidence: The statement uses the ordinary and relative Chern characters on F and T*F. The exact earlier Chern-character definition is for finite CW complexes and pairs. Although finite-CW-model suppliers are listed, the statement does not define transport to these spaces or its independence from the chosen model. Specify this extension using naturality and homotopy invariance.
